official_sources.title: GDALRasterBand class reference
official_sources.finding: Band NoData is raw; Int64/UInt64 NoData may be lossy through double APIs; scale/offset and unit metadata jointly define decoded value provenance.

official_sources.title: gdal raster info
official_sources.finding: Reports datatype, NoData, unit and full/approx statistics; terminal extrema must reject approximate subsets/overviews.

official_sources.title: PROJ unit conversion
official_sources.finding: Linear vertical unit conversion is explicit; extrema must share one declared unit before subtraction.

official_sources.title: gdal_translate
official_sources.finding: Translate can resample, rescale, unscale, change datatype or assign CRS/scale/offset metadata; derived outputs cannot silently redefine canonical heights.

official_sources.title: gdal raster calc
official_sources.finding: Raster algebra supports explicit output datatype, NoData propagation and NaN expressions; arithmetic QA must pin extent/CRS checks and output type.

official_sources.title: gdal raster unscale
official_sources.finding: Unscaled value is raw*scale+offset and output datatype may change; raw, scale, offset and decoded value must stay together.

official_sources.title: RFC 58 Removing Dataset Nodata Value
official_sources.finding: NoData metadata can change or be removed and sidecar loss can change validity semantics; immutable metadata/mask evidence is required.

official_sources.title: GDAL Band unit API
official_sources.finding: Band unit may be empty when unknown; do not label elevation values metres or feet without proof.

official_sources.title: PROJ vertical grid shift
official_sources.finding: Vertical datum shift depends on grid value, multiplier/sign and optional temporal epoch; all are numeric provenance.

official_sources.title: PROJ general grid shift
official_sources.finding: Grid shift may alter horizontal and vertical coordinates with explicit grid type/interpolation; exact operation provenance is required.

official_sources.title: PROJ axis swap
official_sources.finding: Axis swap can reorder axes and change signs; vertical axis order and direction must be serialized.

official_sources.title: projinfo
official_sources.finding: Exposes operation accuracy, area and grid checks plus ballpark controls; vertical operation selection must be auditable.

official_sources.title: gdal raster pixel-info
official_sources.finding: Reports raw/unscaled values, row/column and VRT contributors for independent terminal replay.

official_sources.title: gdal raster compare
official_sources.finding: Golden compare checks pixels/metadata; official examples show explicit unit-normalized comparison before equivalence.

official_sources.title: RFC 100 Float16 support
official_sources.finding: Float16 is lower precision and may be emulated; precision-sensitive extrema must reject lossy down-casts.

official_sources.title: OGRSpatialReference class reference
official_sources.finding: CRS APIs expose linear units, compound vertical CRS and coordinate epochs; default-unit assumptions require explicit scrutiny.

official_sources.title: PROJ Vertical Offset And Slope
official_sources.finding: Vertical transformation can add constant offset and position-dependent slope in metres; exact operation must be recorded.

official_sources.title: PROJ pipeline operator
official_sources.finding: Adjacent pipeline steps must have compatible units and global parameters affect steps; serialized pipeline is numeric provenance.

official_sources.title: gdalwarp vertical transformation
official_sources.finding: Warp can automatically apply vertical corrections with vertical CRS/grid metadata and supports coordinate epochs/custom pipelines.

official_sources.title: gdalsrsinfo
official_sources.finding: WKT2/PROJJSON expose CRS axes, units, datum and dynamic frame details for exact vertical provenance.

official_sources.title: gdal raster set-type
official_sources.finding: Smaller output datatypes may truncate or round values; canonical extrema/difference must precede lossy conversion.

official_sources.title: gdal raster edit
official_sources.finding: Raster/PAM metadata and approximate statistics can be edited; cached numeric metadata cannot replace immutable readback.
